body:
From the current code, LCP profiles are not auto-matched by lens metadata.

The auto path is only the Lensfun mode: `LensProfilePanel::read()` / `onCorrModeChanged()` call `LFDatabase::findCamera(metadata->getMake(), metadata->getModel())` and `LFDatabase::findLens(..., metadata->getLens())` for the Lensfun auto-match radio button.

The LCP path is separate. The UI has a file chooser filtered to `*.lcp`, `write()` stores the selected filename in `pp->lensProf.lcpFile`, and processing later loads exactly that path with:

```cpp
LCPStore::getInstance()->getProfile(params->lensProf.lcpFile)
```

So a user-side alias file like `EXIF lens name -> .lcp path` is not something ART currently reads.

The practical options today are:

1. keep using `LCP file` mode and save the selected `.lcp` in a processing profile/preset for that lens;
2. add or update the lens in the Lensfun database, then use `Automatic (Lensfun)`;
3. open this as a feature request for an LCP alias/mapping table. The implementation would need to map `metadata->getLens()` to an LCP filename before `lensProf.lcpFile` is used, because the processing side currently only receives a concrete file path.
